votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of November 14, 2023, and December 8, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of December 5, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved three sets of prior meeting minutes: the November 14 and December 8, 2023 work session minutes and the December 5, 2023 formal meeting minutes.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future meeting on the Landscaping and Buffers Chapter Text Amendment ordinance.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed amendments to Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code regarding landscaping and buffers, and deferred a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Ratify the election of Council Member Petro as Chair and Council Member Wharton as Vice Chair of the Salt Lake City Council.
votes.description: The Council formally ratified the selection of Victoria Petro as Council Chair and Chris Wharton as Vice Chair for calendar year 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 1 of 2024 Airport Board Code Revisions.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending Section 2.14 of the Salt Lake City Code regarding the Airport Board and related boards and commissions provisions.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting a public hearing date for Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2023-24, appointing Nathan Rafferty and Luz Escamilla to the Airport Board, reappointing Van Turner to the Mosquito Abatement District Board, reappointing Ginger Cannon to the Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry and Trails Advisory Board, and reappointing Tanya Hawkins to the Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
